idleCashNote: 2026-10 study: parking idle cash in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (3% band) raised the walk-forward record of the selection procedure from 8.6% to 10.8-12.2%/yr (2010-2026; SPY 12.0%; the range depends on when SPY is sold to fund a fill) and F6b 2007-2026 from 11.9% to 14.7-16.0%/yr with about the same max drawdown (22-23%).
